TrustUs.heading: A Faster, Cheaper and Safer Shipping!
paragraphs: Are you looking for a faster, cheaper and safer way to ship your goods? Gzavnilli invites you to enjoy the fastest and safest shipping services to Georgia

With over 12 years of excellent service delivery, Gzavnilli boasts of over 40,000 active customers served from our 7 offices from around the globe and did more than 250,000 Kgs of parcels sent on last year alone.
If you are looking for the best services at the best shipping rates to Georgia, get in touch with Gzavnilli, your trusted partner for shipping your goods from the USA to Georgia.

We guarantee the safety of your goods, speedy delivery, affordable prices and a variety of options to choose from depending on which service suits you most. Besides, we use our vehicles and license which means your goods are always in safe hands at all time.
TrustUs.closingParagraph: If you are looking to shop online too, we have an incredible variety of online stores from which you can buy and ship to tax-free state, Delaware. Our listed online stores offer fantastic discounts, deals, and coupons. Just choose a store, buy an item(s), use any of our office addresses and declare the parcel in your account using the tracking number of your order. The rest is on us!

items.question: Gzavnilli Shipping Days
items.answer: Both Regular and Express services send parcels three times a week. Express service departure days are Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday while Regular parcels happen on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday.

items.question: How long is transit time?
items.answer: Transit time for Express service From New York to Tbilisi is 3 calendar days (from day of departure), for regular shipment average time is 5-7 days.

items.question: How can I find office working schedule?
items.answer: We are open throughout the year, except on Easter, Christmas and New Year. Check our contact us page for more details on this.

items.question: Does Gzavnilli Offer the Cheapest and Fastest Shipping Service?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer the cheapest, safest and fastest parcel services from the USA to Georgia. Our shipping services are unique, and no other company can match our standards and efficiency.

items.question: Which Payment Methods Does Gzavnilli Accept?
items.answer: We accept almost all type of payments: PayPal, Debit or credit card payment, checks, money orders, cash, bill pay (from your online banking), wire transfer and bank deposit.
